title: 2005 AMC 10A Problem 8
statement: In the figure, the length of side \(AB\) of square \(ABCD\) is \(\sqrt{50},\) \(E\) is between \(B\) and \(H,\) and \(BE = 1.\) What is the area of the inner square \(EFGH?\)

solutions.text:
The triangles \(ABH,\) \(BCE,\) \(CDF,\) and \(DAG\) are congruent right triangles. In \(\triangle BCE\) the hypotenuse is \(BC = \sqrt{50}\) and \(BE = 1,\) so \(CE = \sqrt{50 - 1} = 7.\) Since \(BH = CE = 7\) and \(E\) lies on \(BH\) with \(BE = 1,\) the inner square’s side is \(EH = 7 - 1 = 6,\) giving area \(6^2 = 36.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: The four corner triangles, such as \(\triangle ABH,\) are congruent right triangles
Each corner triangle is right with hypotenuse \(\sqrt{50}\) and one leg \(BE = 1;\) the inner square’s side is the other leg minus \(1\)
